title: Heavy Duty Mortar and Pestle, Natural Marble Mortar and Pestle Set, Spice Herb Grinder Make Fresh Guacamole, Salsa, Pesto, Stone Grinder Bowl, 1.5 Cup
description:
About this item
Built to Last: this heavy-duty, externally polished solid mortar and pestle set is hand-carved from a single piece of naturally occurring marble! Your heavy duty guacamole bowl grinder will look great on any countertop and will do for many years to come.
Unique Tools for the Kitchen: the outside of the mortar and pestle are polished and honed to give a beautiful and unique pattern, making each item one of a kind.
Unique Design: We changed the traditional design style, repeated experiments and designed the mortar to be easier to grip, so that you can save a lot of effort when making various flavorful sauces.
Multi-purpose: This marble mortar is very strong,and it can be easily finished by grinding dry or wet ingredients. Mortar and pestle set can be used to make homemade guacamole, pesto, salsa, and can easily mash garlic, pepper, ginger, nuts, herbs or spices, etc.
EASY TO CLEAN: The smooth mortar and pestle is very easy to clean, simply wipe it with detergent and it will shine like new, also dishwasher safe.
reviews_5s:
Absolutely gorgeous!
The mortar fits perfectly in one hand and is not too heavy; while the pestle is a perfect weight and size for grinding many things. Although i have only used it once, so far, I was able to grind frankincense resin into a fine powder in a matter of minutes. The top/opening is smaller than the bell/bottom, so it definitely helps prevent material from flying out, although it can take some finesse to keep this from happening.
Cleaning is quick and straightforward, and the smooth surface helps prevent material from getting embedded in the bowl.
Overall, this product is easy to use and clean, and well worth the money. I look forward to utilizing this beautiful work of art for many, many years to come.Heavy duty granite mortar with rough inside rinses easily between uses. Heavy duty pestle in matching black granite does most of the work of grinding. Lightly pounds and grinds finely without much effort. Stays in place with the silicone base. Excellent size and weight for multiple uses of grinding raw materials to coarse or fine powder. Useful in the kitchen or the workshop.Beautiful and heavy, exactly what I was hoping for. Small enough to be held in one hand, and comes with a little rubber mat for when I'm using it on the counter.I bought this as a present for my son, who is a passionate and fussy chef, as he was always stealing my mortar and pestle. Mine is nice, but this one is MUCH nicer - very deep, solid and heavy. I expect it will be more versatile than the standard one - hold more and less likely to spill over.Very nice. Arrived well packaged and intact. I always worry about chips and breakage when buying things like this. The size is perfect.Good quality.Thus is very nice. Made well. Just right to crush my spices.Works wellI adore this mortar and pestle. It's absolute perfection. The first one arrived in a banged up box, and I was saddened to see that it had a chip in it. The replacement arrived in perfect condition. The exterior has a lovely smooth polish and the inside is a bit rougher to facilitate grinding. The bottom is unpolished, and there is a little silicone trivet included to keep it from sliding around or scratching your surfaces.

It's heavy, large and perfect. In addition to being functional, it's just beautiful.

Because it's marble, I'd beware of using it for acidic foods. Acid can damage marble really quickly. Even using it for guacamole with some lime juice can be enough to ruin the finish. Also, though it's marked as dishwasher safe, it's best hand washed.Es un excelente producto, versátil y muy lindo. Queda muy bien en mi cocina. Me ha sido muy útil. Sin dudas una excelente compra.
